messages:
leo_finance: FYI customer MedFrame's payment failed this morning. ACH verification returned 'intermediary routing failure' and our attempt at 08:15 didn't clear. Invoice INV-9999 on annual plan. Need recommended fallbacks.
anya_support: I pinged them. They say their AP team used a virtual account provider and shows a successful debit on their side (trace ID VAP-7782) but our bank couldn't map the intermediary. They asked if we can accept the trace and grant temporary access.
carmen_sales: MedFrame is a strategic account. Sales requests a 48h grace if we can verify the trace quickly. Card on file was removed last quarter.
leo_finance: Proposed steps: 1) Request remittance and ACH trace PDF from customer; 2) Offer wire instructions as fallback and ask for same-day wire; 3) If valid trace provided, allow provisional access up to 48h while Treasury reconciles, require PO# in remittance. I'll also flag invoice for manual review and pause automated dunning for 48h.
anya_support: Draft message to customer (please review):

Hi MedFrame AP team,

Thanks for the trace ID VAP-7782. To reconcile please reply with the bank remittance PDF and, if possible, the originating bank's trace confirmation. If you prefer to avoid intermediary issues, you can initiate a same-day wire to the details below and reply with the confirmation PDF.

Wire details (placeholder):
Bank: Redwood Community Bank
Account: Redwood Inference (Finance Ops)
Account number: XXXX-XXXX
Routing: XXXXXX
Reference: INV-9999 / VAP-7782

If we receive a valid trace and remittance before EOD, we will provisionally restore access for up to 48 hours while Treasury clears funds. Please upload docs here: https://pay.redwood.example/upload

Thanks, Redwood Billing

leo_finance: Looks fine. Add line: 'Provide PO number in payment reference for automatic matching.' And log the failure code 'INTERMED_ROUT' on the invoice.
payments-bot: Manual retry window set for 48 hours from 1785012345. If no trace/wire received, invoice will move to standard dunning.
